description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion on a 100x100 grid, chemical A quantized to a subtractive-color palette and drawn as filled cells
notable: Gray-Scott feed/kill params drive the pattern; color index maps chemical concentration to palette bands

description: Sidewinder maze distance-colored into regions, each region flood-filled by nalee space-filling walkers in pipe/solid path style
notable: Sidewinder maze + BFS distance grid define color regions; PolyBool unions cells into polygons that clip separate nalee walker domains

description: Sidewinder maze distance-colored into regions filled by nalee walkers in solid style, using shuffled found-color palettes (carmen/bless)
notable: Variant of sujni-basic swapping in shuffled found-color palettes with fewer walkers

description: Sidewinder-maze nalee fill at coarse cell size with distressed path style, then downscaled and Atkinson-dithered over the whole frame
notable: distressedStyle nalee cells plus Atkinson dither give a worn woven-cloth texture

description: Sidewinder-maze distance regions filled by nalee walkers rendered in polka-dot line style over a mindful/auto-albers palette
notable: polkaLine path style renders walker paths as dotted trails

description: Fixed 32x32 sidewinder maze distance-colored into regions filled by fine nalee walkers in solid style, forming a corner-to-corner gradient
notable: Start at [0,0], end at far corner so BFS distance yields a diagonal color gradient across regions

description: Sidewinder-maze nalee fill where each region gets a randomly chosen path style (solid, pipe, stitch, thin, polka)
notable: Mixed per-region path styles make each color patch read as a different woven stitch

description: Small 6x6 sidewinder maze distance regions filled by nalee walkers drawn in a normals-based style over a mindful palette
notable: withNormalsStyle renders walker ribs from path normals; coarse maze yields large blocky regions

description: Sidewinder-maze distance regions filled by nalee walkers in stitch path style, evoking embroidered running-stitch seams
notable: stitchStyle path rendering references the sujni/kantha hand-stitch the series is named for

description: Grid of squares whose size pulses via sin of a random x/y offset function over time, downscaled and Atkinson-dithered
notable: Random offset function (x-y, x*y, x/y, etc) sets the phase field driving square-size oscillation

description: Grid of size-pulsing squares like not-as-much-tau but with TAU redefined to 4 instead of 2pi, retuning the wave frequency; Atkinson-dithered
notable: TAU hardcoded to 4 (not 2pi) deliberately detunes the oscillation period

description: Grid of squares displaced and resized by sin/cos of x over time across a range of TAU*TAU, then Atkinson-dithered
notable: Both position and size wobble by trig of x; grid range derived from TAU squared

description: Static field of horizontal wobbly ribbons built from Chaikin-smoothed polylines extruded along their normals with a tapering spread envelope
notable: Uses polyline-normals to extrude each smoothed spine into a closed lens-shaped ribbon

description: 72 thin vertical tentacles rising from the lower canvas, each wobbling by a sum-of-sines and cast with a soft offset shadow accent, grass-like
notable: Dense count and low-amplitude spread turn the tentacle system into swaying blades of grass

description: 12 vertical tentacles built from normal-extruded spines, each wobbling by a sum-of-sines with a translated accent layer behind
notable: Per-tentacle phase offset by index makes the group undulate out of sync

description: The standard tentacle animation with an offset accent layer, downscaled and Atkinson-dithered over the whole frame
notable: Same wobbling tentacles as standard, finished with a 0.35-scale Atkinson dither pass

description: Monospace ASCII/box-drawing field recursively subdivided into rectangles, each woven from weft line/density/ascii/randomart charts crossed by warp waves
notable: Weft/warp terminology treats scrolling terminal line-charts as textile; warp lines only draw over odd weft indices to fake over-under weaving

description: Terminal-chart weave like compositions but laid out via five hand-designed modular-grid layouts (A-E) of overlapping panels instead of recursive splits
notable: Swiss-style modular layout functions place panels on a shared module grid; tweakpane rebuilds layout live

description: Static multi-series terminal line charts (Sonnet/Opus/Haiku metrics) drawn as box-drawing glyphs with y-ticks, date labels and legends on dark ground
notable: The realistic-looking data (nice ticks, spiky/trending/flat series, month labels) is the original from which the abstract weave variants grew

description: Full-canvas monospace weave of 18 weft line/density charts crossed by 14 warp waves, over/under masked by parity, on a random palette
notable: No rectangle framing; the whole grid is one cloth of scrolling weft rows and warp columns

description: Cellular-automaton growth from a single center seed with von-Neumann neighbor rules, cells colored by age in cycling HSL on near-black
notable: Scratch/test file; custom growth rule (birth on exactly one active neighbor) plus age-driven hue

description: Palette proof sheet: a single texel-random display-p3 palette shown as evenly padded horizontal color strips on its background swatch
notable: Utility swatch viewer for the texel-random palette generator

description: Palette comparison sheet: the texel palette generated across seven color spaces (xyz, oklab, oklch, srgb, p3, a98, rec2020) as side-by-side columns of strips
notable: Each column is the same palette rendered in a different color space to compare gamut/appearance

description: A single magenta circle animated along keyframed position and diameter tracks with mixed easings via @daeinc/timeline, on dark ground
notable: Demo of the @daeinc/timeline keyframe/easing library rather than a finished piece
